tests.name: accept_valid_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept returns true for a valid JSON string payload.

tests.name: accept_escaped_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly handles escape sequences inside strings without retaining buffer copies.

tests.name: accept_unicode_surrogate
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept checks unicode surrogate pairs properly in strings.

tests.name: accept_invalid_control_char
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects unescaped control characters inside strings.

tests.name: accept_with_comments
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept works correctly when allow_comments option is enabled.

tests.name: accept_with_trailing_commas
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept handles trailing commas when enabled via accept parameters.

tests.name: accept_empty_input
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly handles empty or whitespace-only inputs.

tests.name: accept_stream_input
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept accepts std::stringstream inputs correctly.

tests.name: accept_iterator_list_input
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept works with container iterators like std::list.

tests.name: accept_deeply_nested
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept handles deeply nested structures without failing or buffer overflows.

tests.name: accept_large_numbers
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly passes over large integers and floating-point values without storing string/number buffers.

tests.name: accept_malformed_utf8
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept catches malformed UTF-8 sequences within string literals.

tests.name: accept_unclosed_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects unclosed string literals.

tests.name: accept_invalid_escape
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept detects invalid escape characters inside string tokens.

tests.name: accept_unicode_escape_short
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects truncated unicode escapes in strings.

tests.name: accept_agreement_with_parse_no_exceptions
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept agrees with parse(..., allow_exceptions=false) on arbitrary inputs.

tests.name: accept_multiple_root_values
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects multiple root values separated by whitespace.

tests.name: accept_hex_number_bad
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly flags improperly formatted hexadecimal or number prefixes.

tests.name: accept_lone_surrogate
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept catches lone high surrogates not followed by a low surrogate.

tests.name: accept_string_with_null_byte
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept handles embedded escaped null bytes correctly within strings.

tests.name: accept_unicode_surrogate_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept checks unicode surrogate pairs properly in strings.

tests.name: accept_lone_surrogate_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept catches lone high surrogates not followed by a low surrogate.
